name: Last.fm 1K User Listening Dataset
description: A collection of listening histories for 992 users, containing timestamped play events and associated user, artist, and tag information. It is used for music recommendation and user listening-behavior research.
citation: Celma, O. (2010). Music Recommendation and Discovery in the Long Tail. Springer. https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-642-13287-2
